metadata.notes: The supplied sliced assets model the HUD and background. The unsliced hero character is treated as scene content and is intentionally omitted. New skill run: five navigation controls each declare normal/selected states; state geometry is represented by separately sized visual groups, with inactive branches retained. Two quest records remain a non-scrolling fixed-size collection to protect central scene space. Right actions distribute fixed-size controls along a height-adaptive group. Background stays centered at 1672x941; viewports larger than the art expose margins. Accepted substitutions from the draft were visually rechecked. Right-action artwork intentionally overlaps by 37px at native size; the row/column resolver clamps distributed negative gaps, so explicit top/middle/bottom constraints preserve that artwork arrangement while adapting group height.
